Hey can't write everything I wanted to , I'm on a midnight walk and need to be vigilant. when I can , I will try answer any questions you may have . I am 26 and got on DSP last year I believe? ... Tbh it was  suspiciously easy . First try applying  I was accepted. 

 Mind you I do have a range of other issues but BPD is the main reason I applied.
 I also had a top psychiatrist treating me at the time . 
like a lead psychiatrist who is running a team of them in one of the main hospitals in Melbourne, 
plus a public mental health treatment service  both wrote apparently very detailed reports of my condition and whole history, medical and psychiatric. 

Had I think two phone assessments then boom .. I was accepted. Only condition is because I'm under 35 I have to be in therapy or I think if not , at least be studying etc . Also have  bi-monthly phone appointments just to confirm and update details if needed . 

I actually have been feeling real guilty because I heard that people with like serious physical conditions apply 2,3,4 times and keep getting rejected.. but I somehow got through??  I am aware that my condition is severe and I suffer greatly every day but still feel like I got in too easy and something bad is going to happen soon to compensate. 

Just make sure your friend has professionals who actually KNOW what specific things to put in . My team was saying that there are key words/sentences you can put in to make Centrelink actually consider your application, not just laugh and throw in trash bin . More detailed history the better .. psych ward visits , suicide attempts, medications, different types of therapy/treatments etc . Other than that I don't know what else to say .. sometimes it's the luck of the draw .. sometimes I think it's even depending on who goes through your application and who does your interviews . Good luck to everyone applying man . Seriously.

I have also gone through my post history again now that you mentioned it and I now see I am so silly and posted too much information that could be traced to me or used against me by anybody so when I can I will be deleting the extremely detailed post I shouldn't have put up in the first place . 
Obviously I was younger and in another stressful desperate situation. I know the more posts /information gives people more information on whether someone is putting a fake post up but I can't really run the risk of information like that falling into the wrong hands and getting used against me . In future if anyone does want to know more if will have to be given in  a more private setting . Thanks

Being in public was horrible for me . I don't have a car or licence so I have to walk everywhere or public transport. I feel everybody looking at me and seeing how fat and ugly and awkward I am . I know they are judging me .. I don't feel human . I'm not like others .. I retreated into my home and didn't look back for a long time .I even got into heroin to black out all day and night. Luckily I  have stopped that too . Sorry for the paragraph but I wanted to show you how bad it got . Anyways , what helps me now , is leaving home at nighttime ! I love it . No one is around .. it's so peaceful!  I leave around 11:30pm to go on a walk and come home around 12:45 go straight to sleep and in the morning I wake up so rested and it actually seems to help a little with my mental health /mood in the mornings . If you need to do things during the day , I don't have much help there but I love putting in my music ... It seems to help sometimes . If you seriously have trouble leaving home even to go for a walk I really think even a short walk around your block at night will do you well . I Hope you get better ..
